scenes.question: What special behavior applies to blob responses larger than 16 KB?
scenes.heading: Blobs larger than 16 KB are served as 302 redirects, and only a limited set of headers can be customized on them
scenes.body: The source says blobs larger than 16 KB are served as 302 redirects, and only a limited list of headers can be customized on them, such as Content-Disposition and Cache-Control.
